{
  "job_id": "DIRECTOR-FAILOVER-FULL-TEST-20260907",
  "department": "CLOTHING",
  "status": "REPAIR",
  "clothing_decisions": {
    "identity_dependency": "Clothing review is conditional because the authoritative Inaria identity specification, reference version, and change log are missing. Clothing must not define, alter, or compensate for unresolved identity.",
    "locked_requirements": [
      "Preserve established Inaria identity, age presentation, body proportions, skin tone, hair identity, and recognizable facial markers.",
      "Do not permanently lock one outfit, shoe, accessory, color, hairstyle interaction, or silhouette unless explicitly required by the canonical brief.",
      "Maintain practical fit, plausible garment construction, clean intersections, visible limb separation, stable hands and feet, and generation-safe layering.",
      "No production assets may be created during this test."
    ],
    "adjustable_choices": [
      "Garment category, seasonal styling, color palette, silhouette, footwear, accessories, fabric weight, layering, and occasion may vary after identity approval.",
      "Hair-compatible collars, necklines, hats, hoods, scarves, and earrings may be adjusted without changing the established hairstyle or hairline.",
      "Use simple, readable construction with limited high-risk details such as thin straps, complex fasteners, excessive jewelry, transparent layers, or dense patterns."
    ],
    "proposed_controlled_variation": [
      "Season: warm-weather, transitional, and cold-weather styling.",
      "Occasion: everyday, smart-casual, and location-appropriate practical looks.",
      "Silhouette: balanced variation across fitted, relaxed, layered, and structured shapes while preserving anatomy readability.",
      "Footwear: varied stable shoes appropriate to scene and pose; avoid extreme heels or unstable sole geometry.",
      "Accessories: restrained variation using bags, belts, scarves, watches, or simple jewelry without facial occlusion.",
      "Color: rotate coordinated neutrals, muted color accents, and seasonal palettes; avoid treating any single color as canonical."
    ],
    "generation_stability": [
      "Prefer opaque, medium-weight fabrics with clear seams and predictable drape.",
      "Avoid garments that merge with skin, hair, background, hands, feet, or major joints.",
      "Keep sleeves, hems, collars, waistbands, and footwear clearly separated from anatomy.",
      "Do not use excessive layered clothing, dangling accessories, reflective surfaces, intricate prints, or ambiguous openings that may destabilize generation.",
      "Validate clothing across pose and camera changes so fit and intersections remain plausible."
    ],
    "handoff_result": "CLOTHING can provide conditional styling variants, but final integration, failover, diversity, and QA traceability remain blocked until the canonical Inaria identity record is supplied."
  },
  "locked_constraints": [
    "Established Inaria identity must remain unchanged across all Director handoffs and failover routes.",
    "Face, hair identity, age presentation, body proportions, skin tone, and recognizable markers take priority over clothing decisions.",
    "Clothing, footwear, accessories, colors, and seasonal styling must remain adjustable unless explicitly locked by an approved brief.",
    "Clothing must support Inaria identity rather than define it.",
    "Garments must have practical fit, plausible construction, clean intersections, and generation-stable geometry.",
    "Anatomy and generation stability take priority over decorative clothing complexity.",
    "JSON-only department output is required.",
    "No production assets may be generated during this integration test."
  ],
  "intentional_variations": [
    "Vary season, occasion, location suitability, color, silhouette, footwear, accessories, layering, and fabric weight.",
    "Coordinate neckline, collar, headwear, scarves, and jewelry with the established hairstyle without overriding Character decisions.",
    "Use restrained, readable styling variants to support dataset diversity while preserving identity and anatomy.",
    "Keep all clothing variation reversible and non-canonical unless explicitly approved and versioned."
  ],
  "notes": [
    "Status is REPAIR because the Character handoff confirms that the authoritative Inaria identity reference and version are unavailable.",
    "Do not finalize clothing locks, approve identity-sensitive hairstyle interactions, or complete end-to-end failover validation until the identity record is available in shared GitHub memory.",
    "Downstream handoffs must preserve Character locked_constraints and intentional_variations without mutation.",
    "This is a test-only evaluation; no production assets were created."
  ]
}
